milestones.title: M1: Repository and Deployment Skeleton
milestones.description: Create the monorepo foundations, static frontend, backend API skeleton, deployment paths, CORS, and login/session flow.

issues.title: Create monorepo structure for frontend, backend, and docs
issues.body:
## Goal
Create the baseline repository layout described in the PRD.

## Scope
- Add `frontend/`, `backend/`, and `docs/` directories.
- Add root README with local setup and architecture notes.
- Add `.gitignore` entries for Python, Node, env files, build outputs, and local databases.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Repository has clearly separated frontend, backend, and docs workspaces.
- Secret-bearing files are ignored.
- README explains how to run each workspace locally.

issues.title: Scaffold React/Vite TypeScript frontend for GitHub Pages
issues.body:
## Goal
Create the static dashboard app shell.

## Scope
- Initialize React + Vite + TypeScript.
- Configure `VITE_API_BASE_URL` for backend calls.
- Add basic routes/layout for dashboard, uploads, review queues, audit, and settings placeholders.

## Acceptance Criteria
- `npm run build` succeeds.
- Frontend contains no RTM, Gemma, or session secrets.
- App can be deployed as static assets.

issues.title: Set up GitHub Pages deployment workflow
issues.body:
## Goal
Deploy the frontend to GitHub Pages from GitHub Actions.

## Scope
- Add GitHub Actions workflow for installing, building, and publishing frontend assets.
- Configure base path if needed for project pages.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Workflow builds the frontend.
- Deployed frontend is accessible through GitHub Pages.
- Runtime secrets are not embedded in the static build.

issues.title: Scaffold FastAPI backend with health and session endpoints
issues.body:
## Goal
Create a minimal authenticated backend foundation.

## Scope
- Initialize FastAPI app with `/health`, `/api/login`, `/api/logout`, and `/api/session`.
- Add settings loading from environment variables.
- Add cookie or bearer session token support for single-user MVP login.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Backend starts locally.
- `/health` is reachable without authentication.
- Protected API routes reject unauthenticated requests.

issues.title: Configure backend CORS and deployment environment documentation
issues.body:
## Goal
Make the backend safe to call from GitHub Pages only.

## Scope
- Restrict CORS to `FRONTEND_ORIGIN`.
- Document required backend environment variables.
- Add deployment notes for Cloud Run, Railway, Render, or Fly.io.

## Acceptance Criteria
- CORS is not wildcarded in production configuration.
- Required env vars are documented without real secrets.
- Frontend can display backend online/offline state.

milestones.title: M2: RTM Read-Only Integration
milestones.description: Authenticate with Remember The Milk, fetch lists/tasks, normalize task JSON, and show status/counts without writes.

issues.title: Implement RTM OAuth/token flow
issues.body:
## Goal
Connect the single-user account to Remember The Milk through the backend.

## Scope
- Implement RTM auth URL generation and callback handling.
- Sign RTM requests server-side.
- Store auth token securely for the MVP.

## Acceptance Criteria
- User can initiate RTM connection from frontend.
- Backend stores RTM token outside browser code.
- `/api/rtm/status` reports connection state.

issues.title: Fetch RTM lists and incomplete tasks
issues.body:
## Goal
Read current RTM source-of-truth data.

## Scope
- Implement RTM list fetch.
- Implement task fetch for active/incomplete tasks.
- Handle RTM API errors cleanly.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Backend returns normalized list and task data.
- Failed RTM calls are logged and surfaced to frontend.
- No RTM write methods are called in this milestone.

issues.title: Normalize RTM tasks into internal snapshot shape
issues.body:
## Goal
Map RTM API responses into the PRD task snapshot fields.

## Scope
- Extract list IDs, taskseries IDs, task IDs, names, notes, tags, dates, priority, estimate, URL, recurrence, completion/deletion state.
- Compute stable `state_hash`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Normalized task objects match the PRD data model.
- State hash changes when task state changes.
- Parser handles missing optional RTM fields.

issues.title: Display RTM connection status and task counts
issues.body:
## Goal
Show read-only RTM status on the dashboard.

## Scope
- Show connected/disconnected state.
- Show list count and active task count after sync.
- Add clear error state for auth or RTM API failures.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Dashboard reflects backend RTM status.
- User can trigger read-only sync.
- Errors are actionable and non-technical where possible.

milestones.title: M3: Database and Audit Foundation
milestones.description: Add persistence for users, RTM connections, snapshots, proposals, source documents, action proposals, audit logs, and settings.

issues.title: Add SQLAlchemy database setup and migrations
issues.body:
## Goal
Create a durable persistence foundation.

## Scope
- Configure `DATABASE_URL`.
- Add SQLAlchemy models/session handling.
- Add migration tooling and initial migration.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Local SQLite works for development.
- Postgres-compatible schema is supported for deployment.
- Backend tests can create an isolated test database.

issues.title: Implement core persistence models
issues.body:
## Goal
Represent PRD data models in the backend database.

## Scope
- Add models for users, RTM connections, task snapshots, AI task proposals, source documents, extracted chunks, action proposals, audit logs, and app settings.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Models cover the PRD-required fields.
- Sensitive token fields are designed for encryption or secure storage.
- Timestamps are stored consistently in UTC.

issues.title: Store RTM task snapshots during sync
issues.body:
## Goal
Persist every fetched task snapshot for later proposal validation.

## Scope
- Save normalized RTM tasks after sync.
- Deduplicate or version snapshots using `state_hash`.
- Expose snapshot listing endpoint.

## Acceptance Criteria
- `/api/tasks/snapshots` returns stored snapshots.
- Task references can be validated against stored snapshots.
- Snapshot storage avoids noisy duplicate rows where appropriate.

issues.title: Add audit logging service and API
issues.body:
## Goal
Make model proposals, user decisions, RTM writes, blocked operations, and failures auditable.

## Scope
- Add service helper for audit events.
- Implement `GET /api/audit` and `GET /api/audit/{id}`.
- Log sync and auth-related failures where useful.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Audit events include event type, entity references, source, result, reason, and timestamps.
- Audit API requires authentication.
- Frontend can render an audit log placeholder view.

milestones.title: M4: Task Maintenance Review
milestones.description: Generate Gemma maintenance proposals from RTM snapshots, validate structured JSON, and display proposed changes without writes.

issues.title: Build Gemma client with JSON-only response handling
issues.body:
## Goal
Call Gemma 4 31B safely through the backend.

## Scope
- Add configurable Gemma base URL, API key, and model.
- Implement JSON-only request/response handling.
- Retry malformed JSON once with a repair prompt.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Gemma credentials are never exposed to frontend.
- Invalid JSON fails safely after one repair attempt.
- Model and prompt version are available for audit logs.

issues.title: Create daily maintenance prompt and output schema
issues.body:
## Goal
Ask Gemma to classify existing tasks and propose maintenance changes.

## Scope
- Build prompt for classifications, risk, confidence, reasons, and proposed changes.
- Define Pydantic schema for task maintenance output.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Prompt requires JSON only.
- Schema matches PRD maintenance contract.
- Prompt includes safety rules and protected categories.

issues.title: Validate task maintenance proposals
issues.body:
## Goal
Block unsafe, malformed, stale, or unsupported model output.

## Scope
- Validate task references, confidence, risk, protected tags, due-today/P1/recurring safeguards, and unsupported fields.
- Split safe, review-required, and blocked proposals.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Destructive operations are always blocked.
- `do_not_touch` tasks are not modified.
- Blocked proposals include clear reasons.

issues.title: Display task maintenance proposals in review-only mode
issues.body:
## Goal
Let the user inspect proposed maintenance changes before any writes exist.

## Scope
- Add Task Maintenance Review page.
- Show current task, proposed changes, reason, confidence, and risk.
- Add disabled or placeholder approve/reject/edit controls pending later milestones.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Daily review can produce visible proposals.
- No RTM writes occur from this UI in M4.
- Risk and blocked reasons are visible.

milestones.title: M5: Safe Auto-Apply
milestones.description: Implement validated low-risk RTM updates, safety gates, idempotency, and audit logs for automatic maintenance edits.

issues.title: Implement RTM write client for safe task updates
issues.body:
## Goal
Add RTM write capabilities needed for safe maintenance.

## Scope
- Implement timeline creation where required.
- Implement add/remove tags, rename, move list, set priority, set due date/start date where supported, and set estimate.
- Surface RTM errors clearly.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Each RTM write is wrapped in typed backend methods.
- Failed writes mark proposals failed.
- No delete or complete task methods are exposed to automation.

issues.title: Add safety gate for auto-apply eligibility
issues.body:
## Goal
Ensure only safe high-confidence changes can be applied automatically.

## Scope
- Enforce confidence threshold.
- Block P1, due-today, recurring, high-risk keyword, destructive, legal/medical/tax/visa/financial/payment/contract tasks, and protected tags.
- Respect `ENABLE_AUTO_APPLY`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Auto-apply is impossible below threshold or when disabled.
- Risky items go to review instead of write.
- Safety decision is audit logged.

issues.title: Implement idempotent safe auto-apply workflow
issues.body:
## Goal
Apply safe proposals without noisy repeated changes.

## Scope
- Skip duplicate tags/notes.
- Validate task state hash before applying.
- Store applied proposal status and audit records.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Re-running the same review does not reapply identical changes.
- State mismatches block writes.
- Every RTM write has an audit record.

milestones.title: M6: Review Queue
milestones.description: Build user approve/reject/edit flows for maintenance proposals and apply approved changes safely.

issues.title: Build unified proposal review queue UI
issues.body:
## Goal
Give the user a central place to review pending proposals.

## Scope
- Show pending task-maintenance proposals.
- Add filters by risk, status, confidence, and proposal type.
- Show details and audit history link.

## Acceptance Criteria
- User can find all pending maintenance proposals.
- Proposal details are understandable before approval.
- Blocked proposals are labeled clearly.

issues.title: Implement approve/reject/edit endpoints for maintenance proposals
issues.body:
## Goal
Let the user decide on review-required maintenance proposals.

## Scope
- Implement approve, reject, and edit endpoints.
- Re-run validation on edited proposals.
- Apply approved changes through RTM write client.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Rejected proposals are not applied.
- Edited proposals are validated before write.
- User decisions are audit logged.

issues.title: Wire maintenance review actions in frontend
issues.body:
## Goal
Make approve/reject/edit usable from the dashboard.

## Scope
- Connect buttons/forms to backend endpoints.
- Show pending/applied/rejected/failed states.
- Refresh proposal list after actions.

## Acceptance Criteria
- User can approve, reject, and edit proposals.
- RTM write failures are visible.
- UI does not allow actions on stale or blocked proposals without edit.

milestones.title: M7: File Upload and Text Extraction
milestones.description: Upload supported files, store source document records, extract text, and preview extraction results.

issues.title: Implement backend file upload validation and storage
issues.body:
## Goal
Accept MVP-supported file uploads safely.

## Scope
- Implement `POST /api/uploads`.
- Validate file type and `MAX_UPLOAD_MB`.
- Hash content and detect duplicates.
- Store source document metadata and retention preference.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Unsupported files are rejected clearly.
- Duplicate files are detected by hash.
- Uploaded file metadata is persisted.

issues.title: Extract text from MVP file formats
issues.body:
## Goal
Convert supported uploads into text for action extraction.

## Scope
- Support `.txt`, `.md`, `.csv`, `.json`, `.html`, `.htm`, `.eml`, `.pdf`, `.vtt`, and `.srt`.
- Track line/page/timestamp metadata where available.
- Store extracted chunks.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Extraction status is `pending`, `extracted`, or `failed`.
- Failed extraction never sends empty text to Gemma.
- Extracted chunks include source location metadata where possible.

issues.title: Build upload page and extracted text preview
issues.body:
## Goal
Let the user upload files and inspect extracted text.

## Scope
- Add drag-and-drop upload page.
- Show supported file types, file size limit, and retention option.
- Show upload/extraction status and text preview.

## Acceptance Criteria
- User can upload one or more supported files.
- Extraction failures are visible.
- User can delete uploaded source documents.

milestones.title: M8: Gemma Action Extraction
milestones.description: Chunk extracted text, ask Gemma for candidate actions, validate source evidence/risk/confidence, and show grouped proposals.

issues.title: Build action extraction prompt and schema
issues.body:
## Goal
Extract candidate tasks from source documents using structured Gemma output.

## Scope
- Create prompt for candidate actions, non-actionable items, and questions.
- Define schema matching PRD action extraction contract.
- Include date, evidence, risk, and confidence rules.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Gemma returns JSON-only action extraction output.
- Every candidate is required to include source evidence.
- Relative date uncertainty is marked for review.

issues.title: Validate and store action proposals
issues.body:
## Goal
Persist only useful, validated action proposals.

## Scope
- Validate evidence, risk, confidence, supported fields, tag patterns, and source locations.
- Mark blocked/needs-review proposals with reasons.
- Store action proposals and model metadata.

## Acceptance Criteria
- No source evidence means blocked.
- Low-confidence items are not eligible for creation.
- Proposals are grouped by source document and chunk.

issues.title: Display extracted action proposals grouped by source document
issues.body:
## Goal
Let the user inspect candidate actions with evidence.

## Scope
- Add Extracted Actions Review page.
- Show task name, list, tags, dates, priority, estimate, note, evidence, source location, confidence, risk, duplicate status, and reason.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Proposals are grouped by upload/source document.
- Evidence is visible before any approval.
- Blocked and needs-review states are clear.

milestones.title: M9: Create Approved RTM Tasks
milestones.description: Approve/edit/reject extracted actions, create approved RTM tasks with metadata and source notes, detect duplicates, and audit results.

issues.title: Implement approve/edit/reject flows for action proposals
issues.body:
## Goal
Let users curate extracted actions before RTM creation.

## Scope
- Add backend endpoints for approve, reject, edit, merge, and mark already done.
- Wire frontend controls.
- Log decisions.

## Acceptance Criteria
- No extracted action is created in RTM without user approval.
- Edited actions are validated before approval.
- User decisions are auditable.

issues.title: Create approved extracted actions in RTM
issues.body:
## Goal
Turn approved candidate actions into RTM tasks with explicit metadata calls.

## Scope
- Add task via `rtm.tasks.add`.
- Apply list, tags, due/start dates, priority, estimate, URL, and notes where available.
- Verify created task and store RTM identifiers.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Created RTM task includes source evidence note.
- Creation failures are shown and logged.
- RTM identifiers are stored locally.

issues.title: Add duplicate detection before RTM task creation
issues.body:
## Goal
Avoid duplicate task creation from uploaded files.

## Scope
- Compare against pending/approved proposals from same upload and existing incomplete RTM tasks.
- Use task name, project/person tags, due date, evidence, URL/source document.
- Mark possible duplicates and require user confirmation.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Possible duplicates are not silently created.
- Duplicate warnings show compared items.
- User can merge or create anyway when appropriate.

milestones.title: M10: Weekly Project Review
milestones.description: Generate project health summaries, identify stale tasks, duplicates, and projects missing next actions.

issues.title: Build weekly review data selection and prompt
issues.body:
## Goal
Generate project-level weekly planning insight from RTM tasks.

## Scope
- Select project tags, project anchors, next/waiting/blocked/review/someday tasks, and recently completed tasks if available.
- Prompt Gemma for project health and recommended focus.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Weekly review produces structured project summaries.
- Projects missing next actions are identified.
- Stale/questionable tasks are flagged for review.

issues.title: Display weekly review summary
issues.body:
## Goal
Show weekly project planning results in the dashboard.

## Scope
- Add weekly review page/section.
- Show active projects, next actions, risks, missing next actions, stale tasks, and recommended focus.

## Acceptance Criteria
- User can run weekly review manually.
- Summary is readable and actionable.
- Risky recommendations do not write to RTM without approval.

milestones.title: M11: Polish and Settings
milestones.description: Add settings, retention controls, prompt overrides, clearer errors, and optional scheduling for later automation.

issues.title: Build settings API and frontend page
issues.body:
## Goal
Let the user configure app behavior safely.

## Scope
- Settings for backend API URL, timezone, confidence threshold, auto-apply, file retention, RTM list mappings, allowed tags, and high-risk keywords.
- Persist settings in backend database where appropriate.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Settings changes are validated.
- Secret values are not exposed in settings responses.
- Defaults match the PRD recommended MVP defaults.

issues.title: Add manual extraction prompt override
issues.body:
## Goal
Allow rerunning document extraction with custom user guidance.

## Scope
- Add UI field for custom instruction.
- Send instruction to backend extraction rerun endpoint.
- Store prompt version/instruction metadata for auditability.

## Acceptance Criteria
- User can rerun extraction on an uploaded document.
- Custom instruction is recorded without overwriting original evidence.
- Existing proposals remain auditable.

issues.title: Improve error reporting across backend and frontend
issues.body:
## Goal
Make failures clear and recoverable.

## Scope
- Standardize API error shape.
- Show actionable frontend errors for backend offline, RTM failures, extraction failures, validation blocks, and Gemma JSON failures.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Error messages avoid leaking secrets.
- User can tell what to retry or fix.
- Failed operations are audit logged where relevant.

issues.title: Add optional manual-first scheduling hooks
issues.body:
## Goal
Prepare for scheduled daily/weekly reviews without enabling automatic writes by default.

## Scope
- Add disabled-by-default scheduler config for daily and weekly reviews.
- Document deployment-specific scheduler options.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Manual runs remain the default.
- Scheduled runs respect `ENABLE_DAILY_SCHEDULE` and `ENABLE_WEEKLY_SCHEDULE`.
- Auto-apply still respects safety and settings gates.
